print(f'Mean: {mean}')

arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import math
# Using cumulative values from the data
june_cumulative = 73.4
july_cumulative = 74.7
aug_cumulative = 76.1
sep_cumulative = 80.1

july_increase = july_cumulative - june_cumulative
aug_increase = aug_cumulative - july_cumulative
sep_increase = sep_cumulative - aug_cumulative

mean = (july_increase + aug_increase) / 2
variance = ((july_increase - mean)**2 + (aug_increase - mean)**2) / 1  # n-1 = 1
std_dev = math.sqrt(variance)

z_score = (sep_increase - mean) / std_dev

print(f'Monthly increases:')
print(f'  July: {july_increase}')
print(f'  August: {aug_increase}')
print(f'  September: {sep_increase}')
print(f'')
print(f'Mean of July/Aug: {mean}')
print(f'Std Dev: {std_dev}')
print(f'Z-score: {round(z_score, 2)}')
print(f'Is unusual (z > 1.96)? {z_score > 1.96}')
"
